impact_scope.description: S1 introduces a new public PNG image-decoder implementation, including PNG input parsing, decoder call-sequence states, restart behavior, and caller-supplied pixel/work buffers.

evidence: In S0, std/png/decode_png.wuffs and its PNG decoder entry points do not exist, so H0 has no PNG-specific exposure or control obligation.

gap_after.type: missing exposure and controllability for new PNG decoder
evidence: S1 adds public PNG decode_image_config, decode_frame_config, decode_frame, restart_frame, and workbuf_len operations with call_sequence transitions from initial state through image/frame configuration to end-of-data.
H0 compiles only BASE and JSON modules, instantiates only wuffs_json__decoder, and feeds inputs exclusively to decode_tokens; it neither enables nor invokes the new PNG decoder.
H0 does not construct the PNG decoder's required image-decoding calls or control its pixel buffer, work buffer, restart arguments, and call ordering.

new_harness_obligation.description: A harness must enable and instantiate the new PNG module, feed PNG byte streams, and exercise its public image-decoder protocol, including configuration/frame calls and caller-controlled destination, work-buffer, restart, and ordering inputs.
evidence: The entire public PNG decoder and PNG input format are new in S1.
decoder.decode_frame introduces caller-supplied pixel-buffer, work-buffer, blend, and options arguments, while decoder.restart_frame introduces index and I/O-position controls.
The documented call_sequence state machine creates new call-order transitions that had no counterpart in S0.

reason: Within the stable scope of the newly introduced PNG decoder, no gap could exist in S0 because the entry points and format were absent. In S1, unchanged H0 remains JSON-only and cannot compile, reach, or control the new PNG API and state protocol. This creates a concrete new harness obligation, so the delta is NEW.
